name: Call outcome router
description: Turn an AI call summary or note into the next step for your system.
use_when: After every call, with the call summary or transcript as the state, before the CRM is updated.

outcome.instructions: What was the outcome of this call

criteria.meeting_booked: A meeting or demo time was agreed
criteria.callback_requested: The person asked to be called back at a later time
criteria.voicemail: The call went to voicemail or nobody answered
criteria.not_interested: The person said they are not interested
criteria.wrong_number: The number or person was wrong
criteria.do_not_call: The person asked not to be called again

next_step_agreed.instructions: A specific next step with a date or time was agreed
